verdict.rationale: Gitea documents several programmatic, non-UI surfaces for automation. These are an official CLI (tea), an official go-sdk, an action runner for Gitea Actions, and a versioned REST API with a built-in OpenAPI/Swagger document on every instance. Together they let the product be driven headlessly and from CI pipelines. However, the evidence for headless/CI use of the CLI is thin: there is no documentation of non-interactive authentication, CI usage examples or machine-readable CLI output, and the API guide notes no deprecation or backward-compatibility policy. missing for 10: documented non-interactive/CI usage of the tea CLI (token auth, scripting examples, structured output), an API stability/deprecation guarantee, independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: We provide an official go-sdk, a CLI tool called tea and an action runner for Gitea Action.
The OpenAPI document is at: https://gitea.your.host/swagger.v1.json
Extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows to match your unique needs.
